svg.title: The flow from problem to impact

g.text: Start with the problem. End with something that holds.
Name the failure that actually matters, and who pays
Respect latency, cost, trust, and the environment the
Build the smallest complete path from input to
Check whether the person on the other side is better
The flow is problem → constraints → system → impact. The middle is not a detour. It is the path from problem to
